data.name: Ells Tales: Idols
data.detailed_description:
Ells Tales: Idols is a thrilling retro-horror survival game in a world where chickens rule the roost! Explore gloomy locations, solve tricky puzzles, scavenge for supplies, and battle diverse monsters to escape this feathered nightmare.

FEATURES:

  • Exploration: Dive into spacious factory workshops, wander through tangled tunnel networks, and uncover a multitude of hidden rooms with secret passages.
  • Survival: Around every corner, feathered "friends" might lurk, who are clearly not happy to see you. Plus, several epic bosses you'll have to battle throughout the game.
  • Puzzles: Not just running and shooting — use your wits to solve clever puzzles and earn valuable rewards!
  • Controls: Separate control of each of the character's hands. Choose what items are more needed here and now, since there are only two hands.
  • Retro-style: Rough, pixelated design that has become the hallmark of the Ells Tales series.
  • Bonus: Ray tracing for owners of modern graphics cards — let's make reflections great again!

data.short_description: Venture into the dark workshops of a giant factory, where chickens are the most dangerous enemies! Gather weapons, supplies, and fight back against a flock of feathered "friends" in the final chapter of the chicken-themed game series. Can you survive this madness?
data.supported_languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Russian, Japanese, German, Spanish - Spain
